newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Thursday roundup -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Thursday roundup -USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area on Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady. Feedlots reported light to moderate inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 2,400 slaughter steers and 1,800 heifers; 117,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,900 formulated cattle and 800 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 300 head or 8 loads of CME delivery cattle.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 69.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 68.00. Pen mostly Select 1-3 1150 lbs 62.50.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 69.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 67.00.
Wk to date - 117,100 Week Ago - 115,600 Year Ago - 74,100
